public_rationale: Retaining current trajectory as the supplied condition, its required persistence remains unverified. [Sector research](https://www.goldmansachs.com/insights/articles/are-technology-stocks-cheap-now) reports market weakness alongside strong earnings; this does not establish ruin or its cause. If current trajectory is instead treated only as a causal description, the result would be unresolved. Neither reading supports declaring the forecast true or false.
limitations: The distinction between not adjudicable and unresolved depends on how current trajectory is read.
The cited sector assessment describes April 2026, not a complete record through October.
Continued strength would not disprove a forecast without a deadline.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The tech industry's current trajectory will lead it to ruin.

statement.excerpt: But that’s the thing, in many of my newsletters and podcasts, I’ve argued that the current trajectory of the tech industry will lead it to ruin.

our_interpretation: Ruin means a severe, sustained, sector-wide loss of economic strength and standing, not ordinary stock volatility or failure of individual companies.
The surrounding passage identifies the trajectory as shareholder-first management and major commitments to generative AI.
I retain current trajectory as a condition: the relevant management and investment pattern must persist long enough for its alleged consequences to be assessed.
The speaker supplies neither a deadline nor a required duration for that persistence.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence that the described trajectory persisted and caused a broad, sustained collapse in the technology industry's economic strength and standing.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive result establishing that the continued specified trajectory cannot produce the predicted ruin. A period of growth or a recovery alone cannot settle an unlimited forecast.

evidence.explanation: The article reports marked technology-stock underperformance alongside earnings strength and concerns about AI investment returns. That combination does not establish sustained sector-wide ruin or its asserted cause.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A verifiable specification of the trajectory and its persistence, followed by evidence of sustained sector-wide collapse attributable to it. A defined horizon would also permit a meaningful failure test.
